args.body: Take PUBLIC-R-DATA-REPAIR-REQUEST. Berlin is stopped because its actual inputs and workflow do not support our offline service, not because remote work is impossible. Test a buyer-request channel where public tabular inputs could permit immediate useful delivery. Check access, rules, inputs and installed execution capability first; stop after the stated limit. No speculative sample, new site or inferred willingness to pay from ordinary help requests. Submission identity and paid acceptance are separate dependencies. Feedback remains unknown and revenue unverified; preserve existing deadlines.

description: Berlin’s formal specification confirms remote paid mapping, but requires private imagery and live company-account edits; no supported offline deliverable was found. Stop that lead. Test a separate, bounded statistical-data repair opportunity using public inputs. Feedback remains AVAILABLE but unclassified sources and uncertain coverage leave demand unknown; verified funds and revenue remain zero. Account restrictions affect submissions, while payment administration affects paid acceptance—not independent preparation.
